provenance: User statements in hardware chat 01a138e8-582f-7090-8ece-6119c3df7598, retrieved on 2026-10-17; same-size local-frame request and later marker/text corrections
region_boundary: Actual outer paper/pad rectangle; marker centers alone are not the physical boundary
outside_original_frame: Preserve source pixels exactly, with only explicitly identified old marker removal as the user-authorized exception
inside_original_frame: Rectify into a physically justified aspect-preserving target rectangle contained in the original frame; fill vacated areas using background color
old_marker_cleanup: Use complete marker masks associated with the same source frame, including source-neighbor cleanup before final sampling; do not leave old-position fragments
text: Evaluate actual text baselines on held-out targets; preserve sampled source text, do not redraw text
sampling: Compose mappings and sample the original image once
target_aspect_provenance: Measured A4/pad dimensions or another explicit supported basis; do not infer arbitrary physical proportions from one image
calibration: Image-specific grid/text fitting or piecewise image repair is not a real lens calibration or enterprise acceptance result
metadata: Boundary, target rectangle, background, marker masks, H and lens profile must be associated with the source frame/bank/version and committed atomically
